goal: Life Guard VR 品牌标识，用于启动画面、登录页和关于页面

subject.concept: 心形与盾牌的融合设计，心形嵌入盾牌轮廓内，盾牌顶部有医疗十字
subject.symbolism: 守护生命、医疗急救、安全保障，与小程序品牌保持一致的视觉识别

style.rendering: 线性图标（line icon），纯描边无填充，可有轻微的品牌感

prompt: A modern logo icon for Life Guard VR medical training platform, featuring a stylized heart shape centered inside a shield outline, the shield has a classic pointed bottom and curved sides, a small medical cross symbol at the top of the shield, single color #00B4D8 (cyan blue) on transparent background, 512x512 pixels, clean minimalist line-art design, 2px uniform stroke with round linecap and linejoin, no fill, no gradient, no shadow, centered with 48px safe area padding, vector-style clean edges, professional and trustworthy medical branding, the heart and shield are visually unified as one symbol

must_keep: 与小程序 Logo 概念一致
